content_sections.heading: About IISER Bhopal Project Associate-I
content_sections.text: The Indian Institute of Science Education and Research Bhopal is located on Bhopal By-pass Road, Bhauri, Bhopal 462066. The advertised post sits in its Department of Biological Sciences and serves a DRDO-funded research project that aims to establish a novel reverse genetic system for viruses for biomedical research and application. The project's queries are handled by Dr. Debasis Nayak, Associate Professor, Department of Biological Sciences.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Essential qualification: Post-graduate degree in Life Science, Biological Science or any related field, or post-graduate degree in professional courses related to health care science, or BTech degree related fields from a recognized University/Institute. Desirable: Candidate should have either (i) qualified CSIR/UGC NET or GATE or (ii) a National-level examination conducted by Reputed Central Govt. Institutes such as DST, DBT, DAE, DRDO, ICMR, ICAR, IIT, IISc, IISER etc. Knowledge of molecular virology is a plus (Molecular Cloning, Viral assays, Serology). Experience in mammalian cell culture and related assays (Western Blot, RT-PCR). Age limit: The age should not exceed 35 years as on 01 November 2026, with usual relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/Differently abled and exceptional candidate(s) as per the Government norms. The notice does not list the number of years of relaxation for each category. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: HRA is paid in addition to the monthly salary. For candidates without NET, GATE or a National-level examination qualification, the notice describes the Rs. 25,000 amount as consolidated pay with no other allowances. The engagement is on a temporary basis to work full-time in the DRDO-funded project. The length of the appointment is not specified in the notice.

content_sections.heading: IISER Bhopal Project Associate-I Job Description
content_sections.text: As printed in the notice, the Project Associate will: Work towards achieving project objectives in a BSL-2, BSL-3 facility. Conduct relevant experiments. Handle data collection and record keeping. Carry out analysis of results. Report to the Principal Investigator.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IISER Bhopal Project Associate-I
content_sections.text: Open the Google Form given in the notice: https://forms.gle/S6x5aYP7ZwU3dqeL8 (linked under Important Links below). Fill in the form and follow the instructions mentioned in the form. Submit the form on or before the application deadline of 25 November 2026. The notice does not list the documents to attach; any requirements are given in the Google Form itself. For queries, candidates may contact Dr. Debasis Nayak, Associate Professor, Dept. of Biological Sciences, at [email protected] . No other correspondence related to the status of an application will be entertained.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates will be invited for an online/offline interview with the selection committee. No TA/DA will be given for attending the interview. The interview date is not specified in the notice.
